name: Code as Policies
one_liner: Translates natural-language robot commands into hierarchical Python policy code that calls deterministic perception and motion-control primitives.

loop.proposes: A code-generation LLM recursively synthesizes Python policy functions and helper routines from a user instruction.
loop.judged_by: A sandboxed Python interpreter, NumPy/Shapely spatial geometry calculators, and low-level robot impedance controllers execute the policy.
loop.steers: Closed-loop visual and geometric state queries inside the generated control loops adjust robot trajectories online.

headline_result: Executed spatial-geometric manipulation, drawing, and tabletop rearrangement tasks on physical Franka Panda and UR5e robot arms without task-specific training.
caveat: Assumes that the perception primitives (object detectors and pose estimators) accurately ground the variable names referenced in the generated code.
beyond_harness_note: The LLM compiles instructions into executable geometric control code whose loops and spatial math run deterministically on the robot.
algorithmic_authority: Shapely computational geometry library and classical robot motion controller

sources.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control (ICRA 2023 / arXiv:2209.07753)

verification.notes: Checked against Liang et al., ICRA 2023.
